title: Package Details Design Correction
outcome: Prospective customers receive the corrected NoorPath Package presentation with explicit adult, child and infant guest categories plus three truthful payment choices: Pay Full, Milestone and Pay Later.
actor: Unauthenticated prospective customers evaluating a published NoorPath Umrah departure before booking.
modules: Pricing quote calculation interprets the selected payment mode without a database migration.
The web application preserves server-authoritative travel-date, occupancy and base payment-plan data.
Operator package configuration remains the source of package inclusion and exclusion values.
Approved NoorPath Package references and design-system/MASTER.md remain visual authority.
routes: Package Details -> available same-origin sibling date -> /packages/{siblingDepartureId}.
Package Details -> Guests -> adult plus/minus where the exact supported occupancy exists; child/infant rows visible but unavailable.
Package Details -> Room Sharing -> existing authoritative financial preview.
Package Details -> Pay Full, Milestone or Pay Later -> authoritative payment commitment.
Package Details -> Book now -> existing /packages/{departureId}/plan flow with occupancy and paymentMode preserved.
acceptance: Package Details follows the approved NoorPath Package visual language with readable hierarchy and calm density.
Guests visibly includes Adults, Children 2-11 With Bed, Children 2-4 Without Bed and Infants 0-2 Without Bed.
Child and infant controls remain disabled until authoritative operator eligibility and pricing configuration exists.
Adult guest count remains synchronized with supported saleable occupancy without client-side price invention.
Same-origin travel-date navigation and sold-out semantics remain unchanged.
Package, Travel Kit, Umrah Kit and Not Included items use the operator package icon vocabulary.
Pay Full, Milestone and Pay Later show correct pay-today/remaining values, carry through Book now, and create the matching authoritative quote schedule.
Desktop, mobile, keyboard, focus, target-size, axe, 200-percent-text, reduced-motion and no-horizontal-overflow checks pass.
Product Owner visually accepts screenshots for the exact final SHA before merge.
exclusions: Child/infant pricing, eligibility, inventory consumption or operator configuration.
Database migrations, Inventory model changes, Booking schema changes or payment-provider changes.
New airline or supplier integrations, detailed itinerary persistence or invented commercial facts.
